001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.CurrentBatteryV2Response;
007
008/**
009 * One step of a multi-record battery procedure, written on both the Mobi and the t:slim X2 at no
010 * fixed time of day. A sequence starts with {@link #getUnknown10()} = 1 and ends with 0, about 30
011 * seconds per step. Some sequences end after the first step; others run three 1, 2, 3 cycles
012 * first. In the 3 sequences with live battery traffic where the value changed, the final record's
013 * {@link #getCurrentBatteryAbc()} equalled {@link #getUnknown13()} of the earlier records, and the
014 * next {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response} reported that new value as currentBatteryAbc. So this looks
015 * like a re-estimate of the battery's state of charge; that reading is an inference.
016 *
017 * The class name is provisional: opcode 330 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
018 * app's history log list. Fields not named here have not been identified and are exposed raw.
019 */
020
021/**
022 * History log record Battery Estimate Update, opCode 330, size 26.
023 *
024 * <br>
025 *
026 * One step of a multi-record battery procedure, written on both the Mobi and the t:slim X2 at no
027 * fixed time of day. A sequence starts with {@link #getUnknown10()} = 1 and ends with 0, about 30
028 * seconds per step. Some sequences end after the first step; others run three 1, 2, 3 cycles
029 * first. In the 3 sequences with live battery traffic where the value changed, the final record's
030 * {@link #getCurrentBatteryAbc()} equalled {@link #getUnknown13()} of the earlier records, and the
031 * next {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response} reported that new value as currentBatteryAbc. So this looks
032 * like a re-estimate of the battery's state of charge; that reading is an inference.
033 *
034 * The class name is provisional: opcode 330 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
035 * app's history log list. Fields not named here have not been identified and are exposed raw.
036 *
037 * 
038 * <table border='1'>
039 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
040 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>330</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
041 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Battery Estimate Update"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
042 * </table>
043 */@HistoryLogProps(
044    opCode = 330,
045    displayName = "Battery Estimate Update"
046)
047public class BatteryEstimateUpdateHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
048
049    private int unknown10;
050    private int unknown11;
051    private int currentBatteryAbc;
052    private int unknown13;
053    private int unknown14;
054    private int lipoMv;
055    private int currentBatteryIbc;
056    private long elapsedMs;
057
058    public BatteryEstimateUpdateHistoryLog() {}
059    public BatteryEstimateUpdateHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int unknown10, int unknown11, int currentBatteryAbc, int unknown13, int unknown14, int lipoMv, int currentBatteryIbc, long elapsedMs) {
060        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
061        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, unknown10, unknown11, currentBatteryAbc, unknown13, unknown14, lipoMv, currentBatteryIbc, elapsedMs);
062        this.unknown10 = unknown10;
063        this.unknown11 = unknown11;
064        this.currentBatteryAbc = currentBatteryAbc;
065        this.unknown13 = unknown13;
066        this.unknown14 = unknown14;
067        this.lipoMv = lipoMv;
068        this.currentBatteryIbc = currentBatteryIbc;
069        this.elapsedMs = elapsedMs;
070    }
071
072    public int typeId() {
073        return 330;
074    }
075
076    /**
077     * <table border="1">
078     * <caption>Parsed fields for BatteryEstimateUpdateHistoryLog:</caption>
079     * <tr><td><code>unknown10</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
080     * <tr><td><code>unknown11</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
081     * <tr><td><code>currentBatteryAbc</code></td><td><code>raw[12] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
082     * <tr><td><code>unknown13</code></td><td><code>raw[13] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
083     * <tr><td><code>unknown14</code></td><td><code>(short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
084     * <tr><td><code>lipoMv</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
085     * <tr><td><code>currentBatteryIbc</code></td><td><code>raw[18] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
086     * <tr><td><code>elapsedMs</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
087     * </table>
088     */
089    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
090        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
091        this.cargo = raw;
092        parseBase(raw);
093        this.unknown10 = raw[10] & 0xFF;
094        this.unknown11 = raw[11] & 0xFF;
095        this.currentBatteryAbc = raw[12] & 0xFF;
096        this.unknown13 = raw[13] & 0xFF;
097        this.unknown14 = (short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
098        this.lipoMv = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
099        this.currentBatteryIbc = raw[18] & 0xFF;
100        this.elapsedMs = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
101    }
102
103    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int unknown10, int unknown11, int currentBatteryAbc, int unknown13, int unknown14, int lipoMv, int currentBatteryIbc, long elapsedMs) {
104        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
105            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(330, 0),
106            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
107            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
108            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(unknown10),
109            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(unknown11),
110            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(currentBatteryAbc),
111            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(unknown13),
112            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown14),
113            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(lipoMv),
114            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(currentBatteryIbc),
115            new byte[3],
116            Bytes.toUint32(elapsedMs)));
117    }
118
119    /**
120     * Step within the sequence: 1, 2, 3 (occasionally 4) while it runs, 0 in its final record.
121     *
122     * @return raw uint8 at offset 10
123     */
124    public int getUnknown10() {
125        return unknown10;
126    }
127
128    /**
129     * 1 only in records where {@link #getUnknown10()} is 3, else 0.
130     *
131     * @return raw uint8 at offset 11
132     */
133    public int getUnknown11() {
134        return unknown11;
135    }
136
137    /**
138     * Equal to {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getCurrentBatteryAbc()} before the sequence; in the
139     * final record, the value the pump reports afterwards.
140     *
141     * @return battery percent, 0-100
142     */
143    public int getCurrentBatteryAbc() {
144        return currentBatteryAbc;
145    }
146
147    /**
148     * Often above 100 in the first record of a sequence (always 136 on the Mobi); in later
149     * records, the value {@link #getCurrentBatteryAbc()} takes in the final record.
150     *
151     * @return raw uint8 at offset 13
152     */
153    public int getUnknown13() {
154        return unknown13;
155    }
156
157    /**
158     * Signed; -38 to 213 observed.
159     *
160     * @return raw int16 at offset 14
161     */
162    public int getUnknown14() {
163        return unknown14;
164    }
165
166    /**
167     * Close to {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getUnknown3()} read around the same time.
168     *
169     * @return battery voltage in millivolts
170     */
171    public int getLipoMv() {
172        return lipoMv;
173    }
174
175    /**
176     * @return {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getCurrentBatteryIbc()} before the sequence
177     */
178    public int getCurrentBatteryIbc() {
179        return currentBatteryIbc;
180    }
181
182    /**
183     * Milliseconds since the first record of the sequence (exactly 30000, 60000, 62000, ... on the
184     * t:slim X2, about 30300 per 30-second step on the Mobi); 0 in the final record.
185     *
186     * @return elapsed time in milliseconds
187     */
188    public long getElapsedMs() {
189        return elapsedMs;
190    }
191}
